chu_de: CHI THI #11: mau that deal + CLMCA, boc co che bot
noi_dung:
CHI THI #11 (cloud -> nha). Da doc 60fa + 6487, cam on. Model 4 +5939 gan Model 1 +6482 (-8%): CCBSN v2.6 la tin hieu tot nhat hien co.
MUC TIEU MOI cua chu du an: BOC TACH co che / chien luoc / yeu to dac sac cua TUNG bot de ap dung cheo + ket hop vao he thong va EA sau nay.
Cach cloud lam: .set = ten + gia tri khoa (y dinh tac gia); lenh that cua tester = hanh vi; doi chieu hai cai -> KHOI co che; dung khoi vao luoi.py; ban nhan ban phai khop tung lenh voi hop den. Cloud dang viet bo doc deal + ho so co che, CAN MAU THAT.
QUYET DINH: CHUA niem phong CCBSN (0% tick that + hop den: dung mot lan niem phong tren du lieu yeu la phi). Se niem phong BAN NHAN BAN cua ta. KHONG tai tick Dukascopy luc nay.

VIEC 1 - khong tester, ~10 phut, LAM DAU. Voi 3 lan chay Model 1: (a) CanCuBo v2.6 xac_nhan, (b) CanCuBo v2.6 kham_pha, (c) Vamge10K v3.0.5 kham_pha:
 - bang DEALS day du cua bao cao .htm -> reports/fixture/tester_<ten>_deals.csv.gz, GIU NGUYEN cot goc (thoi gian, deal, symbol, loai, huong, khoi luong, gia, order, hoa hong, swap, loi nhuan, so du, binh luan). Cot BINH LUAN quan trong: EA hay ghi loai/cap lenh vao do.
 - 25 dong dau bang ORDERS (co SL/TP) -> tester_<ten>_orders_mau.csv; 30 dong HTML tho dau bang Deals -> tester_<ten>_html_mau.txt (cloud xem nhan ngon ngu that).
 - .set cua (a) va (c): UTF-16 -> UTF-8 -> reports/fixture/<ten>.set.txt, CHI neu khong co dong giong khoa / mat khau / so tai khoan (.set chi la ten=gia tri).
 - tra loi 1 dong: .htm goc con o dau (de khong bi chay de). Commit + push. KHONG dua .ex5 / .htm goc vao git.
VIEC 2 - tester: CLMCA (MIT, co ma nguon, khong hop den) theo #10 muc B.2: ea_tho_kham -> ea_tho_chay kham_pha cho 5 .set duoi MOT gt_id; .set nao DAT thi xac_nhan DUNG 1 lan; KHONG niem phong.
VIEC 3 - khong tester: ghi 4 lan chay CCBSN vao so tay bang ghi_hieu_biet (nhan 'hop den', Model 1 khao sat; v2.6 Model 4 +5939).
VIEC 4 - 2 phut: bien dich ea_LuoiDayDu.mq5 bang MetaEditor (chi F7, khong chay) de bat loi cu phap MQL5; neu loi thi sua + commit.
B1 / chay tn5 de sau. Xong: MOT thu XONG <= 12 dong. Cloud co the gui #12 (chay ho so co che tren moi bao cao da co) trong ~1-2 gio: chu du an quyet bat tiep hay tat may.
